description: Look up bedrock geology (lithology, rock unit name, and geological age range) near a point in Great Britain, from the BGS 1:625,000 generalised digital geological map. Returns each matching bedrock unit's lexicon name, rock composition, and time period (e.g. Eocene, Cretaceous). Data: British Geological Survey (ogcapi.bgs.ac.uk), Open Government Licence, no auth required.

lat.description: Decimal degree latitude (WGS84) — must be supplied together with lng. Omit both for full Great Britain coverage.

limit.description: Maximum bedrock geology units to return (default 20, max 50)

lng.description: Decimal degree longitude (WGS84) — must be supplied together with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres around lat/lng (default 5, max 50)

name: bgs-ogcapi.geology.bedrock

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: BGS Bedrock Geology Lookup
